(a) single-instant price-derived (price, marketCap, fdv, priceBasis.price, perToken dilution / netOfDilution, holderFlow.netOfDilution, yields.*, line / bucket yields): rel = 2 x the asset's price-token 90-day hourly p99 |chain/CoinGecko-1| (gap-90d.txt) rounded up to 0.5%, 10% where no CoinGecko pair was measured (HYPE, LIT, PUMP, AERO, cvxCRV). (b) USD flow aggregates (revenue, costOfRevenue, grossProfit, holders, protocol, operatingCosts, holderFlow, belowLine, volume, their lines / buckets, perToken flows, unreconciled.annualized): rel 0.02. (c) growth .change abs 0.05, .annualized abs 0.2, .current / .prior rel 0.02. (d) yields.pegTrailing, yields.multiple, multiples.*: rel 0.25.", "Class entries are exact paths, one per USD-derived path of the class present in the asset's proof reports (old or new, either day), whether or not it moved. Fitted entries outside the classes (ratios.payoutRatio, provenance.methods.*, apportion.mix, unreconciled.pct) keep their 2x proof bound. Text: priceBasis.flows (`*`), priceBasis.source / sourceType and each line's priceBasis are value-pinned to the proof's exact old/new.", "Token amounts, supply, grades, counts and every non-USD field (dilution.*, yields.dilution, dilutionLines, shares, haircuts) get no entry. AERO gets class (a) entries only (its flows are not repriced in R2: revenue, holder flow, growth stay exact). No todo placeholders."] | R43 addendum: r2-allowlist.json at orion-2026.11.15.1 plus Mike's 2026-11-17 acceptances (cake/link provenance fp, pump payoutRatio, sky stakers/surplus_usds growth).

*.old: each flow day's USD from its tokens x hourly prices where every hour is priced and the stored value was itself hourly-priced at ingest (the G2-signed days), else the stored value (per line: priceBasis)
*.new: each flow day's USD from its tokens x the chain/first-party hourly prices where every hour with an amount is priced (hourly), or its day amount x the mean of the day's 24 chain hours (daily_mean), else the stored value (per line: priceBasis)
*.reason: R2: the report's flow pricing text names the chain/first-party hourly view (flow_usd_chain_v: hourly or daily_mean) instead of the ingest-time hourly gate (Task 5); same old/new text on all 13 assets in the proof
